scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.test: bun test --parallel --pass-with-no-tests packages apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/scripts apps/mobile/src apps/mobile/scripts
scripts.test:fast: bun test --parallel --pass-with-no-tests $(sed -e '/^#/d' -e '/^$/d' -e 's/^/--path-ignore-patterns=/' test-slow-files.txt) packages apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/scripts apps/mobile/src apps/mobile/scripts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run host:check
scripts.host:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path host/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path host/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --manifest-path host/Cargo.toml
